quote: But you mentioned you're referred by someone? Because we have a great referral program
stewart_read: Rep spends over a minute (02:14-03:14) chasing a referral name/spelling that has no bearing on qualification or booking.
alternative_hypothesis: Could be relationship-building small talk, but it consumes real script time without advancing verify or bill capture.
coaching_implication: Capture referral name briefly and move on faster — this ate nearly a full minute of an already talkative call.

quote: We don't have an exact energy bill or anything like that.
stewart_read: Customer hands the rep a real anchor (prior owner's ~$400/month bill estimate) but the rep never reflects it back as pain to build urgency.
coaching_implication: Rep should have said something like 'so even the prior owner was paying around $400 a month — that's real money going to the utility every month' to turn the number into leverage.

quote: you know, give or take, you know, around 400 a month or something like that.
stewart_read: This is the only bill figure captured on the call, sourced from the prior owner rather than the customer's own usage.
coaching_implication: Flag as capture only, not flip — see anchor_use for detail.

quote: we also wanna lower our carbon footprint,
stewart_read: Customer explicitly states an environmental motivation plus a strong property fit (south-facing 1000 sq ft roof mentioned at 01:49), both strong qualifying signals the rep never explicitly reinforces later.
coaching_implication: Rep should tie the appointment invite back to this stated motivation ('the specialist can show you exactly how much of that footprint you offset') — instead it goes unused.

quote: I mean, what I can do is, I can have a specialist get you an evaluation,
stewart_read: Customer describes an inefficient heating system and active renovation plans (wall heaters, HERS score) — a scope well beyond solar that touches Ion's broader offerings, but rep only routes to solar-specialist evaluation.
alternative_hypothesis: Ion's setter scope may correctly limit this to solar-only, since roofing/HVAC isn't Ion's stated catalog for HVAC work.
coaching_implication: Rep correctly avoided overselling but never confirmed the specialist visit would actually address the customer's stated heating-efficiency framing, which is central to his buying logic.

quote: Great. We will set a tentative appointment for Wednesday, the twenty second at 01:00.
stewart_read: No 'is that fair?' handshake, no explicit one-hour block statement, and no no-driving/computer instruction were given before the call ended.
coaching_implication: Add the full button-up sequence — handshake and logistics instructions correlate with show rate per schema.
